scope_notes: 3h06, 7 lessons, 22 videos and 5 quizzes on prospecting, active buyers, exploratory conversations and personalized sales presentations.
required_resources: Browser and free HubSpot Academy account; no paid software required

component_evidence.pedagogy: Coherent consultative-sales progression from identifying buyers to tailored conversations and presentations.
component_evidence.depth: Useful specialist foundation but only about three hours.
component_evidence.practice: Five quizzes plus certification assessment; no extended role-play project verified.
component_evidence.materials: Integrated videos, transcripts, examples and certification prep.
component_evidence.currency: Live 2026 route; core sales method is fairly stable though CRM examples can age.
component_evidence.expertise: HubSpot Academy instructors and sales practitioners have direct sales/CRM experience.

recommendation_rationale: Strong concise consultative-sales foundation; not a comprehensive sales-development programme.

scope_notes: 5h18, 10 lessons, 38 videos and 29 quizzes on strategy, listening, content, reach, social ads, ROI, governance and crisis planning.
required_resources: Browser and free HubSpot Academy account

component_evidence.pedagogy: Moves from strategy/listening into content, reach, advertising, measurement and governance.
component_evidence.depth: Good strategic breadth without deep platform-operator specialization.
component_evidence.practice: 29 quizzes create unusually dense retrieval practice for the duration.
component_evidence.materials: Polished integrated videos, transcripts, examples and certification assessment.
component_evidence.currency: Active route but still surfaces legacy platform references such as Twitter; fast-moving platform content warrants a penalty.
component_evidence.expertise: Experienced social-media strategists and practitioners teach the route.

recommendation_rationale: Strong strategy course with exceptional quiz density; current-platform supplementation is still needed.

scope_notes: 3h59, 12 lessons, 31 videos, 9 quizzes and one practical exercise covering personalization, automation, copy/design, analytics, A/B testing and privacy.
required_resources: Browser and free HubSpot Academy account

component_evidence.pedagogy: Follows email strategy from audience/personalization through automation, content, testing and analysis.
component_evidence.depth: Good channel-specific depth for a four-hour certification.
component_evidence.practice: Nine quizzes, one practical exercise and certification assessment.
component_evidence.materials: Integrated videos, examples, study resources and assessment.
component_evidence.currency: Email fundamentals are comparatively stable and the course includes current automation, privacy and testing practices.
component_evidence.expertise: HubSpot Academy has direct lifecycle/email marketing expertise.

recommendation_rationale: Strongest channel-specific email route in the current pool: concise, practical and well assessed.

scope_notes: 6h52, 11 lessons, 32 videos and 9 quizzes covering RevOps fundamentals, flywheel analysis, SLAs, team structure and strategy iteration.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisites; prior sales/marketing context is useful
required_resources: Browser and free HubSpot Academy account

component_evidence.pedagogy: Connects RevOps concepts to friction, accountability, team design and process alignment.
component_evidence.depth: Substantial specialist breadth for an emerging operations field.
component_evidence.practice: Nine quizzes and practitioner examples; no large capstone verified.
component_evidence.currency: Live 2026 route; core process/alignment concepts remain current.
component_evidence.expertise: HubSpot Academy and current RevOps practitioners provide direct expertise.
component_evidence.accessibility: Free, self-paced and certificate-bearing without paid CRM requirements.

recommendation_rationale: Strongest specialist RevOps route in the pool; especially useful across marketing, sales and customer-success operations.

scope_notes: 3h48, 11 lessons, 34 videos and 10 quizzes on paid-media strategy, targeting, creative, conversion paths, social/programmatic advertising and measurement.
required_resources: Browser and free HubSpot Academy account; no paid ad spend required

component_evidence.pedagogy: Campaign-planning sequence from audience/objectives through targeting, creative, conversion and measurement.
component_evidence.depth: Useful workflow breadth but not deep platform-operator training.
component_evidence.practice: Ten quizzes plus workbook-style application; live campaign execution is not required.
component_evidence.materials: Videos, examples, workbook resources and certification assessment.
component_evidence.currency: Platform interfaces, targeting and privacy change quickly; live course lacks a public revision log, so currency is conservative.
component_evidence.expertise: HubSpot Academy instructors have direct digital-advertising experience.
component_evidence.accessibility: Free, self-paced, certificate-bearing and no ad spend required.

recommendation_rationale: Strong paid-media strategy primer; pair with current platform documentation because tactics and rules age quickly.

scope_notes: 2h20, 7 lessons and 19 videos on AI search visibility, E-E-A-T, SEO/AEO integration, AI citations, structured data and measurement.
prerequisites: No formal prerequisites; basic SEO familiarity helps
required_resources: Browser and free HubSpot Academy account; examples use Search Console and GA4

component_evidence.pedagogy: Progresses from answer-engine change into planning, citation optimization and measurement.
component_evidence.depth: Useful specialist foundation but compact for an emerging field.
component_evidence.practice: Framework/audit application is emphasized more than dense graded exercises.
component_evidence.materials: Current examples, measurement guidance and certification resources.
component_evidence.currency: Exceptionally current 2026 coverage of AI Overviews, citations, answer engines and measurement limitations.
component_evidence.expertise: HubSpot Academy instructors specialize in search and digital-content strategy.
component_evidence.accessibility: Free, self-paced, short and certificate-bearing without coding prerequisites.

recommendation_rationale: Most current search-discovery route in the category; excellent 2026 AEO primer despite compact scope.

credential: Free Saylor course-completion certificate; optional ACE credit uses paid proctoring
academic_credits: ACE-recommended college credit available only through the optional separately proctored route
scope_notes: 30-hour, seven-unit general marketing course covering principles, STP, research, product life cycles, pricing, supply chains, distribution, promotion, campaigns and social media.
required_resources: Web-capable device, internet and free Saylor account

component_evidence.pedagogy: Full marketing process from customer analysis and positioning into product, pricing, distribution, promotion and campaign planning.
component_evidence.depth: Broadest general marketing foundation among current survivors.
component_evidence.practice: Repeatable unit assessments plus a free final exam.
component_evidence.materials: Curated readings, lectures, videos and activities; source consistency is mixed.
component_evidence.currency: Syllabus last modified 2 October 2025 and includes social-media marketing.
component_evidence.expertise: Faculty-reviewed curriculum; named practitioner authorship is less transparent than HubSpot.
component_evidence.accessibility: Course, final exam and certificate are free; optional ACE proctoring is separate.

recommendation_rationale: Best broad general-marketing foundation in the survivor pool; HubSpot routes are stronger for channel specialization.
